profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer Manager @ Boeing Defense, Space & Security
profile.summary:
With over nine years of experience in software engineering and leadership roles, I currently serve as a Senior Software Engineer Manager at Boeing Defense, Space & Security. My focus is on fostering a culture of value-driven, secure software delivery and leading teams to achieve high performance through effective technical leadership and agile methodologies.  

My expertise lies in technical leadership and information technology, with a commitment to aligning product strategies with customer needs and operational excellence. I am dedicated to improving team performance, managing talent, and enabling scalable solutions that address complex challenges in the engineering domain.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Drove strategic roadmaps, new value propositions, risk-reduction priorities. Fostered a culture of value-centric secure software delivery, through customer engagement, product strategy, requirements analysis, functional test, vulnerability remediation, dependency and risk management, O&M support.

- Launched new ART in 2023, following an organizational realignment; lauded as the highest performing ART on the program for 12+ months
- Navigated multiple ART expansions—100% and 75% growth—as new value propositions were introduced

- Managed all aspects of employee performance and retention, compensation and recognition, and talent acquisition

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Working with customers and other engineers to define requirements, such as understanding and agreeing upon the function of software system 
• Architect and designing software to meet current and future requirements 
• Implement software using a variety of technologies and implementation software languages 
• Testing implementation at a low-level, than with the software in the rest of the system, and finally as a system on the real hardware used by the customer. 
• As a Software Engineer I work with a team in a casual but professional environment where there is long-term potential for career growth into technical leadership or management positions.

educations.schoolName: University of Arkansas at Pine Bluff
